stopRules: Only one fresh matched screening pair at 4 operations/second is authorized; stop for review after two runs.
Stop immediately for invalid evidence, safety failure, controller/cleanup failure, changed provenance or competing containers.
Retain performance failures and inconclusive observations; no automatic repeat, higher rate, confirmation or fault trial.
Pauses require a complete matched pair and verified cleanup/restoration; a completed pair cannot resume into more work.
Two hours is a cumulative safety ceiling, not a predicted finish time; preserve historical evidence and rules.
